title: Law Firm Management System
overview: The Law Firm Management System provides legal practice management capabilities including user authentication, case management, real-time client-lawyer chat, calendar scheduling, document management, and automated billing. It enforces role-based access control across Firm Admins, Lawyers, and Clients while meeting performance and security requirements.
